istem: Vertical 9:16 frame. Stylized semi-realistic 3D render of a professional football match, like a modern football video game replay. High-angle TV broadcast camera looking down diagonally at the pitch near the penalty area; the top 12% of the frame shows a packed crowd in the stands above a plain blue advertising board with no text. Bright green grass with wide diagonal mowing stripes, crisp white pitch lines, the penalty-area line and the curved penalty arc visible on the right. Players are small full-body figures seen from above at an angle, with soft contact shadows: three players in plain solid red kits (red shirt, red shorts, red socks) and four players in plain white kits (white shirt, white shorts, white socks), dynamic running poses, generic faces. Clean, sharp, vibrant colors, soft daylight. No text, no letters, no numbers on shirts, no logos, no badges, no watermark. Scene: players spread from the middle to the bottom of the frame; one red player dribbles the ball forward while white defenders track back.
